mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS processing, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed FROM douban_crawl_task

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS processing, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 OR status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed FROM author_crawl_task

SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN info_page_status = 0 AND review_page_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS pending, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (info_page_status IN (1, 2, 4) OR review_page_status IN (1, 2, 4)) AND NOT (info_page_status IN (2, 4) AND review_page_status IN (2, 4)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS processing, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN info_page_status IN (2, 4) AND review_page_status IN (2, 4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS completed, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN info_page_status = 3 AND review_page_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS failed FROM resource_link_crawl_task
